## Design

### 2026-11-06: I started creating the schematic and pcb for my devboard. One obstacle was that the guide had a crystal that had 4 pins, but all my crysta symbols had 3 or less. It seemed that the more recent crystal

**5h**

I started creating the schematic and pcb for my devboard. One obstacle was that the guide had a crystal that had 4 pins, but all my crysta symbols had 3 or less. It seemed that the more recent crystal oscillators only have 3 pins, so I had to adjust for that. Following the guide was pretty easy, and I had a lot of time to design the board. Once I find my pcb images I'll put it in the next entry.
